ext.description: Build your Lakehouse's Data Quality framework with DQX — profiling, contracts and AI, versioned in Git.
cmd.profileTable: DQX Forge: Generate contract from profiling
cmd.refreshCheckCatalog: DQX Forge: Reload DQX check catalog
cmd.generateWithAi: DQX Forge: Generate contract with AI
cmd.runContractJob: DQX Forge: Run a contract's checks
cfg.profile: Profile from ~/.databrickscfg used to connect. Empty uses DEFAULT.
cfg.catalogFilter: Catalogs shown in the tree. Empty shows every accessible one.
cfg.contractsDir: Repository folder where quality contracts are versioned.
cfg.dqxVersion: Version of databricks-labs-dqx installed on the serverless jobs.
cfg.volumePath: Unity Catalog volume where jobs write intermediate results.
cfg.warehouseId: SQL warehouse for the AI agent and the dashboard. Use 'DQX Forge: Choose SQL warehouse'.
cfg.schedule: Quartz expression scheduling the generated jobs. Empty deploys them without a schedule. Use 'DQX Forge: Choose job schedule'.
cfg.timezone: IANA time zone the schedule's cron is interpreted in.
cfg.aiRoute: Where the AI runs. Use 'DQX Forge: Choose AI model' to set it.
cfg.aiEndpoint: Serving endpoint used on the Databricks route. Set by the model picker.
cfg.aiIdeModel: Identifier of the IDE model used when the route is 'ide'.
